For purposes of this section: 6 a. “Child care worker” means a person employed by a child 7 care provider and whose primary duties involve the provision of 8 child care to children in this state. 9 b. “Community” means a geographic area designated by the 10 department under subsection 4. 11 c. “Fund” means the child care solutions fund created under 12 subsection 2. 13 2. A child care solutions fund is created within the state 14 treasury under the control of the department. The fund shall 15 consist of all of the following: 16 a.
